color.note: Neutral first. Ink on warm off-white, one accent (Infisical yellow in both themes), status colors that always travel with a word or icon. The app is a sidebar beside an inset, both light in light and both dark in dark. Dark mirrors light: ink becomes bone, the accent takes over the on switch and the mark, and selection stays neutral.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Near-black ground. The dark-theme sidebar sits on it (through sidebar); in light the sidebar is light and nothing in the app shell uses frame. It never wraps the inset. Never put text on it except inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: frame-soft
tokens.usage: Warm ground for embedded views and docs that want a frame around their content. In dark it matches frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main panel and every inset card, input, menu and dialog. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: The app's main content area beside the sidebar. It sits straight on the page with no frame, and pads space-40 (bottom space-48). Always surface, so cards and tables read the same inside it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Ground of the app sidebar. tint in light (1.1:1 against the inset, so it needs sidebar-line) and frame in dark. Text on it uses ink, text2 and muted: muted is 6.4:1 in light and 9.6:1 in dark. The current page is sidebar-current with ink text; counts are accent Counts, and a rail dot, which has no number, is accent-fg.

tokens.name: sidebar-line
tokens.usage: The 1px rule between the sidebar and the inset, and separators inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of nav rows and buttons in the sidebar. A step darker than the light sidebar (tint alone would vanish on it), a step lighter than the dark one.

tokens.name: sidebar-current
tokens.usage: The current page in the sidebar, and a rail group that holds it: ink at the press step over the sidebar (10% over tint in light, 18% over frame in dark), a step past sidebar-hover (1.25:1 against the light sidebar where hover is 1.10:1; 1.49:1 in dark where hover is 1.22:1). Ink text on it at 600 is 14.6:1 in light and 12.2:1 in dark. Neutral, like every selection; in the sidebar only counts take the accent.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet footers. A step off surface so the action bar reads as a shelf.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Borderless shells around inset surfaces (cards, tables, lists), table headers, segmented tracks, disabled and read-only fields, the hover ground of striped table rows, and the light sidebar (through sidebar). In dark it is lifted so a borderless shell still reads against surface (1.15:1).

tokens.name: row-done
tokens.usage: Resolved list items that stay in place so nothing jumps.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selection in connected rows: a list's current and checked rows, selected table and tree rows, DataGrid ranges, the pressed toggle Button. On rows it is the whole signal, with the row text one step up (text2 to ink, muted to text2); no edge bar. Neutral in both themes, never tinted: in dark it is 1.30:1 on surface and a step above tint (1.13:1), the same step as before.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a surface, skeleton blocks, progress tracks, soft badges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of inset surfaces, plain cards, compact lists, popovers and dialogs; section rules. Shells around inset surfaces have no border.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Source pair: 2.1:1 on surface in light and 2.0:1 in dark, below the 3:1 floor for control borders. Kept exact; focus turns the border ink with a 3px nudge outline. An invalid field rests on bad-control and turns bad with the 3px bad outline while focused.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and separators like the breadcrumb slash only. 3.0:1 on surface in light (6.3:1 in dark): never for text people must read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, eyebrows and captions. 7.1:1 on surface, 6.4:1 on tint in light; 9.0:1 and 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Body copy that sits one step below ink: descriptions in alerts, table cells, ghost button labels. 12.5:1 on surface in light, 13.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, tint, paper and select (at least 17:1 in light, 13:1 in dark). Also the fill of primary buttons, checked controls and person avatars.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: primary buttons, checked checkboxes, person avatars, tooltips.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Counts (in the sidebar and the bulk action bar), the on switch knob, approval buttons and search highlights; the current page in the sidebar stays neutral. Infisical yellow in both themes: #e3ef59 in light, #e7f256 in dark. On light grounds the fill is nearly as light as the ground (1.10:1 on the sidebar, 1.21:1 on surface) and carries no edge: it is a highlight, and what it says is its on-accent text (16.7:1 on it), so the label, not the fill, identifies the control or the number. Never let a bare fill with no text carry meaning (a dot, a bar); use accent-fg for those. In dark it stands out on its own (17:1 on the sidebar). A fill, never text on light grounds. For accent-colored text and icons (toast actions, the banner), use accent-fg.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of accent buttons. A step darker than accent on the same hue; on-accent on it is 14.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (16.7:1 in light, 17:1 in dark; 14.2:1 on accent-2 in light).

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Very light accent ground for a highlighted row, a callout and the production banner. Text on it is ink (19.4:1 light, 14.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of the production banner and other accent-wash callouts. A step darker than the wash (1.32:1 against it in light), like the status -line colors.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: The accent as text or an icon. Ink in light, where the accent cannot be read; the accent in dark (13.4:1 on toast-bg, 13.9:1 on accent-wash). Toast actions, the banner icon and link, and marks with no text in them, like the rail dot that stands for a count.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The mark's ink when UI draws it, such as the Loader. Ink in light, the accent in dark, the same inks as the logo files.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and dots. 7.7:1 on surface and 6.6:1 on ok-bg in light; 10.2:1 and 8.5:1 in dark. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ok-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside success alerts, on ok-wash (9.9:1 light, 12.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of success badges.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of success alerts.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and near-limit progress. 6.6:1 on surface and 5.5:1 on warn-bg in light; 11.6:1 and 9.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: warn-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside warning alerts, on warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of warning badges.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of warning alerts.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, over-limit progress. 5.8:1 on surface and 4.7:1 on bad-bg in light; 6.4:1 and 5.5:1 in dark. Told apart from ok by lightness and by its word or icon.

tokens.name: bad-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside error alerts, on bad-wash.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of error badges and the icon tile in alert dialogs.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of error alerts; hover of danger ghost buttons.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of error badges and alerts.

tokens.name: bad-control
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid field at rest: bad at the control step (2.1:1 on surface in light, 2.0:1 in dark, like control), so an invalid field rests as quietly as any other. Focus or open turns it bad with the 3px bad nudge outline. The error text under it carries the message.

tokens.name: on-bad
tokens.usage: Label on a bad fill (destructive buttons). White in light (6.0:1), near-black in dark (6.8:1).

tokens.name: bad-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of destructive buttons.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. 8.4:1 on surface, 6.9:1 on info-bg in light; 9.1:1 and 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: info-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside info alerts, on info-wash.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of info badges.

tokens.name: info-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of info alerts.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: sw-on
tokens.usage: Track of a switch that is on. Ink in light, the accent in dark.

tokens.name: sw-knob-on
tokens.usage: Knob of a switch that is on. The light accent in light (16.7:1 against the ink track), ink-black in dark (17:1 against sw-on).

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toasts. Light on light, dark on dark: surface in light, a raised gray in dark (1.2:1 on the dark page). Always with toast-line and shadow-pop.

tokens.name: toast-line
tokens.usage: Border of toasts.

tokens.name: toast-text
tokens.usage: Titles and text in toasts (20.1:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and the dismiss icon in toasts (7.1:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-ok
tokens.usage: Success icon in a toast (7.7:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-bad
tokens.usage: Error icon in a toast (5.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, alert dialogs and sheets.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Big numbers and hero titles inside a page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings, dialog and sheet titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Card titles and empty state titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Page ledes under the display title, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Syncs 14 secrets to GitHub Actions on every push.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, row titles, emphasized values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Field labels (at 600), help text, secondary lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, stage labels, dense metadata, in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase with font-stretch 106%. Breadcrumb eyebrows, card and table headers, menu group labels. Always muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Secret keys, paths, hostnames, identity names, environment slugs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Versions, dates in tables, shortcuts, counts, in muted.

spacing.note: The number is the pixel value. Layouts use the larger steps; controls use 6 to 16.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between icon buttons in a toolbar; title to description in stacked text; tile to tile inside a stepper.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Shell inset: between a tint shell and its content block (cards, tables, lists). Segmented track padding. Menu and listbox padding, so a row's hover ground sits 4px from the outer edge with the border. A field's end padding beside its nested items, so a slot sits 4px from the outer edge with the border.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented tracks and pagination; between step segments; between grouped nested items in a field (reveal and copy, a shortcut and clear).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label to control; badge dot to text; small button icon gap; combobox chip field padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and inputs; buttons inside a row or item.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Small button padding; avatar to name; left and right padding inside text fields, input groups and select, combobox and multiselect triggers. Menu and listbox rows reach the same line: 3px list padding plus 7px row padding, so their text lines up with the trigger's.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Popover padding, both directions; gap between buttons in footers; dialog and sheet footer padding; gap between stacked blocks; alert grid gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Row padding in tables and item lists; default button padding; section heading to content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card, alert and alert dialog padding; gap between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet body padding; gap between checkbox options.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between side by side cards; combobox chip height; gap between header and nav.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between side by side sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Main panel padding; compact list row and tab height.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Main panel bottom padding; table row height.

size.note: Heights shared by controls and badges, so they line up in any row, and the slot that nested items take inside a field (size-nested-*: the field height minus 8px). The width floors live here too: size-cell-min for table columns, size-text-min for item and card text, size-tile-min for tile grids.

tokens.name: size-badge-sm
tokens.usage: Small badge height, inside table rows, item rows and sheet meta; tab count chips.

tokens.name: size-count
tokens.usage: Count chip height, in navigation and tabs.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Default badge height: identity, status and emphasis.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small control height: small buttons and inputs, icon buttons in toolbars, menu items and options, segmented items, pagination pages.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: The default control height: buttons, inputs, input groups, and select, combobox and popover triggers. Icon-only buttons are square at this size.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large control height: large buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-nested-sm
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside a small (32px) field: icon buttons, shortcut hints, clear buttons. 4px from the field's outer edge on every side.

tokens.name: size-nested-md
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside a default (36px) field: the reveal, copy and clear icon buttons, a Kbd hint, a small Badge. 4px from the field's outer edge on every side; slots are 4px apart.

tokens.name: size-nested-lg
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside a large (40px) field or a stacked-label trigger.

tokens.name: size-cell-min
tokens.usage: Floor for every Table and DataGrid column that fits its content. A column can set its own minWidth, or a fixed width.

tokens.name: size-text-min
tokens.usage: Floor for the main text of an item row and of a plain card heading. Buttons and badges beside it keep their width and drop under the text instead of squeezing it; the text truncates, with its full value on hover.

tokens.name: size-tile-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a Tile gets in an ifs-tiles grid; below it the grid drops a column instead of squeezing tiles.

radius.note: Infisical 2.0 is square by default. Each radius is multiplied by the corners token (0 or 1), so these values only appear when a container sets --corners: 1.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, progress bars, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, menu items, options, tooltips, kbd, inline icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented items, media tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, listboxes, popovers, counts, switch tracks, alert dialog icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Plain cards, tiles, alerts, toasts, segmented tracks, data grids and plain list inners. Surfaces inset in a shell take radius-inset.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Tint shells around inset surfaces, dialogs, the main panel.

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Surfaces inset in a tint shell (framed card bodies, framed list inners, table bodies, CodeBlock bodies): radius-panel minus the 3px shell gap, so nested corners stay concentric.

shape.note: The corners switch, as a token.

tokens.name: corners
tokens.usage: Corner multiplier. 0 draws everything square (the default). Set --corners: 1 on any container for soft corners; every component multiplies its radius token by it.

shadow.note: Depth only, never state. Inset surfaces get a 1px lift, overlays get a real shadow, everything else is flat. Focus, selection, errors and pressed states use outlines, borders and color.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Inset surfaces inside a tint frame: cards, tables, lists.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, listboxes, popovers, dialogs, sheets, toasts.

opacity.note: Opacity steps. nudge is the baseline for soft outlines: focused or open inputs, input groups and select triggers draw 3px of ink at this opacity outside an ink border, and invalid ones draw 3px of bad. Fields at rest have no outline. hover and press are how much of an action's own foreground its ground takes. Light and dark have their own values so each can be tuned.

tokens.name: opacity-nudge
tokens.usage: Soft outline opacity in light: 3px of ink at 20% on focus (a 1.6:1 halo), 3px of bad at 20% on a focused invalid field. The ink border carries the contrast (9.6:1 against control).

tokens.name: opacity-nudge-dark
tokens.usage: Soft outline opacity in dark (1.7:1 halo on the dark page). Starts equal to light; bundle.css swaps it in under data-theme dark.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of actions in light: the action's own text color (currentColor) at 6%, over whatever it sits on. Menu options, listbox options, ghost, secondary and icon buttons, tree rows, pagination. Ink at 6% is 1.14:1 on surface, the old select's step; bad at 6% keeps bad text at 5.3:1.

tokens.name: opacity-hover-dark
tokens.usage: Hover ground of actions in dark: currentColor at 12% (bone at 12% is 1.30:1 on the dark surface, where the old yellow select was). bundle.css swaps it in under data-theme dark.

tokens.name: opacity-press
tokens.usage: Pressed ground of actions in light: currentColor at 10% (1.25:1 on surface). Filled buttons hold their hover fill instead.

tokens.name: opacity-press-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed ground of actions in dark: currentColor at 18%.
